map.水光针 (成分/注射量) 配比器 使用指南: Skin booster (ingredient/injection volume) ratio tool guide
map.根据您选择的皮肤问题与治疗目标，计算水光针各活性成分的配比比例、建议浓度与单次总: Based on the skin concern and treatment goal you select, compute the ratio of each skin booster active, the recommended concentration and the total single injection volume, to help design a safe injection plan.
map.各成分体积 = 总量 × 成分比例；含量 = 体积 × 参考浓度；生理盐水补足余: Each ingredient volume = total x ingredient ratio; content = volume x reference concentration; saline makes up the remainder
map.配比逻辑：非交联透明质酸为基底（占 50%，若含 PRP 则降为 30%）；PR: Ratio logic: non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid as the base (50%, or 30% when PRP is included); PRP 30%, vitamin C 10% (at 10% solution), peptides/growth factors 5% (0.5%), micro botulinum toxin 2% (about 5 U/ml, up to 30 U for the whole face), PDRN 15% (capped at 2 ml), glutathione 3% (600 mg/4 ml). Saline = total minus the sum of ingredient volumes, used to top up to the total volume (counted when above 0.1 ml). At least hyaluronic acid or PRP must be chosen as the base. Used for computing skin booster injection ingredients and dosages.
map.面诊沟通：把「打几毫升、含多少 HA」翻译成可量化指标，便于比价。: Consultation communication: translate "how many milliliters and how much HA" into quantifiable metrics for easy price comparison.
map.分区规划：按额/颊/下颌分区分配注射量，避免局部过量。: Zoned planning: distribute the injection volume by forehead/cheek/jaw zones to avoid local overdose.
map.复购记录：记录每次 HA 总量，观察长期水合改善趋势。: Repeat-visit records: log the total HA each time and observe the long-term hydration improvement trend.
map.单次水光 HA 总量: Total HA volume for a single skin booster session
map.：输入：2% HA 共 3mL → 有效 HA 约 60mg，分区约每颊 1mL: : input: 2% HA totalling 3 mL -> about 60 mg of effective HA, about 1 mL per cheek in zoned dosing, with a note to prepare fresh in a facility under sterile conditions.
map.打越多越润吗？: Does more volume mean more hydration?
map.不是。单次总量有安全窗，过量增加肿胀与结节风险。: No. The single total dose has a safety window, and excess raises the risk of swelling and nodules.
map.自己在家打水光行吗？: Can I do skin boosters at home?
map.不行。属医疗注射，有感染、血管栓塞风险，必须机构操作。: No. It is a medical injection with infection and vascular embolism risks, so it must be performed in a facility.
map.本结果可作依据吗？: Can this result serve as a basis?
map.不可。仅为算术换算，实际方案由医师定。: No. It is only an arithmetic conversion; the actual regimen is decided by a physician.
